Upstream source license status

The user-supplied poisson-solver repository at baseline commit
4a1f1bb7e6f9dab6a2934b62d9b8655cf3a9f99a contains no LICENSE/COPYING file
or source license grant in the packaged include/src files. This package does
not invent or imply an upstream license grant. Existing notices are preserved.
Origin: git@gitlab.mff.cuni.cz:d3s/hpc/poisson-solver.git

The separately pinned VkFFT dependency has its own MIT license, copied in
VkFFT-LICENSE. Its license does not relicense poisson-solver.
